title: 🤯 Why Hard Work Won’t Make You Rich (Asset Mindset) #Shorts

subtitles.en:
Alex, I worked sixty hours last week, but my
paycheck, barely moved. What am I doing
wrong?
subtitles.zh:
Alex，我上個星期工作了六十個小時，但我的薪水，
卻幾乎沒有增加。我到底是哪裡做錯了呢？

subtitles.en:
You are trapped, in the classic employee
trap. You are trading hours, for dollars.
subtitles.zh: 妳陷進了傳統上班族的陷阱裡。那就是，用妳的時間，去換取金錢。

subtitles.en:
Trading hours, for dollars? Isn't that, how
everyone makes a living?
subtitles.zh: 用時間去換取金錢？大家不都是這樣謀生的嗎？

subtitles.en:
That is how people survive, not how they
build wealth. If you stop working, your
income, immediately drops to zero.
subtitles.zh:
那只是人們生存的方式，而不是創造財富的方式。
如果你停止工作，你的收入，就會立刻歸零。

subtitles.en:
Ouch! That hurts, because it is true. So,
what is the real alternative?
subtitles.zh: 好痛！這句話真扎心，因為這是事實。那麼，真正的替代方案是什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
Shift from a labor mindset, to an asset
mindset. Focus on building equity, instead of
just selling your time.
subtitles.zh: 將勞動者思維，轉變為資產思維。專注於累積資產，而不是僅僅出售你的時間。

subtitles.en:
Building equity? Do you mean, owning stocks,
or rental properties?
subtitles.zh: 累積資產？你是說，擁有股票，或者是出租房產嗎？

subtitles.en:
Not just that! Even as an employee, you can
build three powerful, transferable assets,
that nobody can take away.
subtitles.zh:
不只是那樣！即使作為一名員工，你也能建立三種強大且可轉移的資產，
而且誰也拿不走。

subtitles.en:
Transferable assets? Quick, tell me number
one!
subtitles.zh: 可轉移資產？快點，告訴我第一個是什麼！

subtitles.en:
Asset number one: scalable, high-income
skills. Learn skills with leverage, like
artificial intelligence tools, copywriting,
or sales systems.
subtitles.zh:
第一個資產：具備可擴展性的高收入技能。學習帶有槓桿的技能，
例如人工智慧工具、文案撰寫，或是銷售系統。

subtitles.en:
Skills that create value, whether I am awake,
or asleep! What is number two?
subtitles.zh: 無論我是醒著，還是睡著，都能持續創造價值的技能！那第二個是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Asset number two: your professional network.
Jobs come and go, but strong relationships,
stay with you forever.
subtitles.zh: 第二個資產：你的專業人脈。工作會換，但強大的關係，會永遠陪伴著你。

subtitles.en:
Your network, is your true net worth. And
what is the third one?
subtitles.zh: 你的人脈，就是你真正的淨資產。那第三個是什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
Asset number three, is the ultimate leverage:
your personal brand, and reputation.
subtitles.zh: 第三個資產是終極槓桿：你的個人品牌，與專業聲譽。

subtitles.en:
When people recognize your expertise, great
opportunities, will hunt you down!
subtitles.zh: 當人們認可你的專業能力時，美好的機會，就會自動找上門！

subtitles.en:
Exactly! That is scalability. Disconnecting
what you earn, from the hours, you physically
work.
subtitles.zh: 完全正確！這就是可擴展性。將你的收入，與你實際工作的小時數徹底脫鉤。

subtitles.en:
So, the golden question changes, from 'How
many hours did I work?' to 'What asset, did I
build today?'
subtitles.zh:
所以，最關鍵的問題就從「我今天工作了幾小時？
」，變成了「我今天建立了什麼資產？」

subtitles.en:
You got it! What transferable asset, are you
building this year? Tell us in the comments,
and subscribe, for more wealth mindset tips!
subtitles.zh:
答對了！你今年正在建立什麼可轉移資產呢？在下方留言告訴 Alex 和
Mia，並訂閱我們，獲取更多財富思維的小技巧！
